prose:
Tranche M is not a seventh plan — it is the EXECUTION tranche whose entire reason to exist is to discharge the two physical chronics that have ridden every fourier plan since G/J: the deploy-of-record that never landed (host 44 commits behind, CONFIRMED this run — worse than the 29 K.md records) and the inv-15 consumer gap (api.ts has zero callers for J's 7 CORE endpoints, CONFIRMED). A1-10 names the deepest pattern in the whole corpus: the recap/idiomatic/fold-chronics meta-directive has been honoured at the PLANNING layer ~6 times while these two chronics keep being re-planned rather than shipped. M resolves that by construction — M.W0 states 'this tranche discharges what J/K planned; it does not re-plan it,' and M's close-gate is physical: observed-green prod + a live UI consumer for every endpoint + a green inv-27 run.

The sequencing has two parallel arms joining at evidence. The FRONT enabler is M.W1, the multi-major dependency reconciliation: glass-ui 4.0.0 / keyframes 4.2.0 / value.js 0.12.0 (all CONFIRMED published; pins still ^3.1.0/^2.2.0/^0.10.0). This is the highest-leverage first move because it greens e2e AT SOURCE (the glass-dock-1 dup-VT blocker that has held CI red since before J is fixed by the useId() shipped in 3.1.1, present at 4.0), un-fixmes the two a11y keystones, and unblocks DEC-2 asideSide + useTextHighlight. The critical re-grounding correction the prior audits all missed: this is a MAJOR bump (3.1.0->4.0.0), NOT the caret-safe one-liner K.md and the 11-days-stale RUN-BOARD assumed — its breaking surface is at least the 21 enumerated mechanical edits (3 UnderlineTabs, 3 DialogContent, 12 MetricBadge, 5 import-path moves) plus the glass-subtle->glass-quiet rename already half-applied in the dirty tree. That rename is only coherent ATOP the resolved 4.0 dep, so the ordering is load-bearing: bump, then commit the rename, never the reverse. Node-20's forced Actions cutover (today, 2026-06-16) folds into the same commit.

The second arm is the deploy spine (M.W2-W4), independent of the bump and runnable in parallel. The root cause is correctly diagnosed and confirmed at code level: no container HEALTHCHECK (only mongo has one), and the FastAPI lifespan builds ~35 indexes serially BEFORE /api/health can answer, so a cold WORKERS=1 start with 44 new commits loses the race against the 60s blind poll and silently rolls back. The fix is idiomatic, NOT a longer poll: move index creation off the serving path (create-after-yield, idempotent) + a real HEALTHCHECK with depends_on:service_healthy (W2); a fail-closed inv-28 green-CI gate that refuses a red SHA (W3, closing the asymmetry where the SPA gates but the API does not); and page() on all three terminal states to a constellation-watched sink with inv-31 authored firmly (W4 — the chain has gone silently-broken-for-months TWICE; observability is not a maybe-invariant). A known-green SHA then flows through the fixed spine and the host finally catches up to HEAD.

The two arms join at M.W5 (wire the consumer gap + transpose the data-model) and M.W6 (evidence). W5 is the binding inv-15 close-gate: the 7 client methods, a /v/:slug detail host carrying the diff-viewer (glass-ui useTextHighlight from /motion at 4.0, with the supported-flag PE floor), provenance breadcrumb, version timeline, forks drill-down, and the remix action — and crucially re-points gallery.publish() off the generic PATCH onto POST /:slug/publish so the idempotent in-place verb is finally exercised. W5 also lands the two data-model transpositions the directive demands: W2-transpose DELETES the phantom within-viz version chain (depth always 0, version_count never incremented, /versions always one entry — dead substrate, net code decrease, inv-3 no-legacy) keeping only the per-viz atom snapshot /diff and the cross-viz fork_of lineage; W2-fix force-resolves the palette_slug-mutable-outside-the-version-model integrity hole, makes the ignored /diff to-param real, and recompiles the migration's empty atom_diff.
